title: STEERING - CONTENTS
summary: Contents of UPC 9, steering: relay (center link) and tie rod assemblies (A2), steering gear (steering box), steering wheel and horn cover (A3), steering column and column support (A4), and the mandatory installation sequence (A5). A drawing of the front suspension and column points to where each sheet applies.
notes_internal: Index page: no parts. Two-line titles joined with a space.
Drawing callouts: A2 relay rod/tie rods, A3 steering gear and steering wheel (two places), A4 column. A1 and A5 not called out.
